name: Chrysos Heirs 先古之民
author: fastbit-ljb
description: Honkai: Star Rail Amphoreus crossover. At the fork behind the last campfire of each act lies an Ancient Trial. Challenge a Chrysos Heir: win to claim their Resonance relic, lose to receive a consolation Ancient relic and lose 10 Max HP. Each heir's trial can only be attempted once per run. 崩坏：星穹铁道翁法罗斯联动。每幕最后一个火堆之后出现岔路：？为先古试炼，额外火堆为补给。挑战黄金裔试炼：成功获得该黄金裔的特色（共鸣）遗物，失败获得一件安慰先古遗物并失去10点最大生命。每位黄金裔的试炼每局仅可挑战一次。
